name: Mavka Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed via mavkaventures.com (mavka.vc 301-redirects there; contact emails are @mavka.vc). The site describes an early-stage embodied-AI / Physical Intelligence fund strategy affiliated with Mavka Capital, with GPs Vitaly Golomb and Stefan Krause. The public LinkedIn company page 'Mavka Ventures' (website mavka.vc, Menlo Park CA, founded 2025, VC & PE principals) and the Mavka Capital team page (mavkacap.com) both name the same two people as GPs. This matches the One Way Summit lead focus (Embodied AI; Robotics). It is NOT Mavka Capital, the affiliated M&A and capital-markets advisory whose listed transactions are sell-side advisory work, not investments. It is also NOT Mavka Growth (GTM advisory affiliate), Maven Ventures, MAVA Ventures, Mav Automation Ventures, or the Ukrainian film 'Mavka'. As of 2026-10-30 the site still says the fund is being formed ('is forming a specialized venture fund') and lists no portfolio.

thesis_text.value: Early-stage fund (still being formed) backing AI-native robotics and embodied-AI companies that bring perception, learning and control into physical systems. It prioritises uses with proven, measurable ROI, often a 12–24 month payback, in manufacturing automation, healthcare robotics, logistics and warehousing, intelligent mobility, and defense and security.

conflicts.reason: The fund's own site (mavkaventures.com/about) lists him as General Partner, and so does the affiliate's team page. 'Managing Partner' appears only on a database mirror and in a newsletter sign-off.

open_items: Rounds: 0 of the 8 required for Tier A. No company press release, investor post, or press article names Mavka Ventures as an investor in any round. The fund site lists no portfolio. The Mavka Capital team page mentions 'Mavka Ventures portfolio companies' in Kip Knight's bio but names none. Searches covered press, Mavka Report newsletter archive, Crunchbase (403), and EDGAR.

Funds: the home page says Mavka Ventures 'is forming a specialized venture fund', and the Nov 2025 Mavka Report says they are 'actively working with LPs'. No fund name, number, target or final size, or close date was found. EDGAR company search and full-text search for 'Mavka' (2026-10-30) return no filings, so there is no Form D.

A fund-size target and a 'leading seed and Series A' claim surfaced only in search-engine summaries of a LinkedIn post. The post was not fetched (LinkedIn feed, outside protocol), so nothing from it is recorded. Fund size and leads are unverified.
leads: no fetched page says whether the fund leads rounds.
check_min_usd / check_max_usd: not stated on any fetched page.
stages: the firm's own pages say only 'early-stage'. 'Seed' comes from the Icebreaker mirror of the GP's LinkedIn (database page). Series A participation is unconfirmed.

invests_in_indian_founders / requires_us_entity: no statement found. The contact form has a Country field. The affiliate Mavka Capital has an Associate Partner in Bengaluru, but that is the advisory arm, not the fund.

HQ comes only from the LinkedIn company page (Menlo Park, CA). No street address is published. Affiliate pages say 'Silicon Valley-based', and the GPs' LinkedIn-mirrored locations say San Francisco Bay Area.
The One Way Summit SF (Oct 28–29 2026) attendee listing given as the lead was not fetched or verified here.
